caustics_refractive.description: Use refractive caustics, resulting in a brighter image (more noise but added realism)

blur_glossy.name: Filter Glossy
blur_glossy.description: Adaptively blur glossy shaders after blurry bounces, to reduce noise at the cost of accuracy

use_guiding.name: Guiding
use_guiding.description: Use path guiding for sampling paths. Path guiding incrementally learns the light distribution of the scene and guides path into directions with high direct and indirect light contributions

use_deterministic_guiding.name: Deterministic
use_deterministic_guiding.description: Makes path guiding deterministic which means renderings will be reproducible with the same pixel values every time. This feature slows down training

guiding_distribution_type.name: Guiding Distribution Type
guiding_distribution_type.description: Type of representation for the guiding distribution

enum_items.name: Parallax-Aware VMM
enum_items.description: Use Parallax-aware von Mises-Fisher models as directional distribution

enum_items.name: Directional Quad Tree
enum_items.description: Use Directional Quad Trees as directional distribution

enum_items.name: VMM
enum_items.description: Use von Mises-Fisher models as directional distribution

guiding_directional_sampling_type.name: Directional Sampling Type
guiding_directional_sampling_type.description: Type of the directional sampling used for guiding

enum_items.name: Diffuse Product MIS
enum_items.description: Guided diffuse BSDF component based on the incoming light distribution and the cosine product (closed form product)

enum_items.name: Re-sampled Importance Sampling
enum_items.description: Perform RIS sampling to guided based on the product of the incoming light distribution and the BSDF

enum_items.name: Roughness-based
enum_items.description: Adjust the guiding probability based on the roughness of the material components

use_surface_guiding.name: Surface Guiding
use_surface_guiding.description: Use guiding when sampling directions on a surface

surface_guiding_probability.name: Surface Guiding Probability
surface_guiding_probability.description: The probability of guiding a direction on a surface

use_volume_guiding.name: Volume Guiding
use_volume_guiding.description: Use guiding when sampling directions inside a volume

guiding_training_samples.name: Training Samples
guiding_training_samples.description: The maximum number of samples used for training path guiding. Higher samples lead to more accurate guiding, however may also unnecessarily slow down rendering once guiding is accurate enough. A value of 0 will continue training until the last sample

volume_guiding_probability.name: Volume Guiding Probability
volume_guiding_probability.description: The probability of guiding a direction inside a volume

use_guiding_direct_light.name: Guide Direct Light
use_guiding_direct_light.description: Consider the contribution of directly visible light sources during guiding

use_guiding_mis_weights.name: Use MIS Weights
use_guiding_mis_weights.description: Use the MIS weight to weight the contribution of directly visible light sources during guiding

guiding_roughness_threshold.name: Guiding Roughness Threshold
guiding_roughness_threshold.description: The minimal roughness value of a material to apply guiding

diffuse_bounces.name: Diffuse Bounces
diffuse_bounces.description: Maximum number of diffuse reflection bounces, bounded by total maximum

glossy_bounces.name: Glossy Bounces
glossy_bounces.description: Maximum number of glossy reflection bounces, bounded by total maximum

transmission_bounces.name: Transmission Bounces
transmission_bounces.description: Maximum number of transmission bounces, bounded by total maximum

volume_bounces.name: Volume Bounces
volume_bounces.description: Maximum number of volumetric scattering events

transparent_max_bounces.name: Transparent Max Bounces
transparent_max_bounces.description: Maximum number of transparent bounces. This is independent of maximum number of other bounces

volume_step_rate.name: Step Rate
volume_step_rate.description: Globally adjust detail for volume rendering, on top of automatically estimated step size. Higher values reduce render time, lower values render with more detail

volume_preview_step_rate.name: Step Rate
volume_preview_step_rate.description: Globally adjust detail for volume rendering, on top of automatically estimated step size. Higher values reduce render time, lower values render with more detail

volume_max_steps.name: Max Steps
volume_max_steps.description: Maximum number of steps through the volume before giving up, to avoid extremely long render times with big objects or small step sizes

volume_biased.name: Biased
volume_biased.description: Default volume rendering uses null scattering, which is unbiased and has less artifacts, but could be noisier. Biased option uses ray marching, with controls for steps size and max steps

dicing_rate.name: Dicing Rate
dicing_rate.description: Multiplier for per object adaptive subdivision size

preview_dicing_rate.name: Viewport Dicing Rate
preview_dicing_rate.description: Multiplier for per object adaptive subdivision size in the viewport

max_subdivisions.name: Max Subdivisions
max_subdivisions.description: Stop subdividing when this level is reached even if the dicing rate would produce finer tessellation

dicing_camera.name: Dicing Camera
dicing_camera.description: Camera to use as reference point when subdividing geometry, useful to avoid crawling artifacts in animations when the scene camera is moving

offscreen_dicing_scale.name: Offscreen Dicing Scale
offscreen_dicing_scale.description: Multiplier for dicing rate of geometry outside of the camera view. The dicing rate of objects is gradually increased the further they are outside the camera view. Lower values provide higher quality reflections and shadows for off screen objects, while higher values use less memory

film_transparent_glass.name: Transparent Glass
film_transparent_glass.description: Render transmissive surfaces as transparent, for compositing glass over another background

film_transparent_roughness.name: Transparent Roughness Threshold
film_transparent_roughness.description: For transparent transmission, keep surfaces with roughness above the threshold opaque

enum_items.name: Box
enum_items.description: Box filter

enum_items.name: Gaussian
enum_items.description: Gaussian filter

enum_items.name: Blackman-Harris
enum_items.description: Blackman-Harris filter

seed.name: Seed
seed.description: Seed value for integrator to get different noise patterns

use_animated_seed.name: Use Animated Seed
use_animated_seed.description: Use different seed values (and hence noise patterns) at different frames

sample_clamp_direct.name: Clamp Direct
sample_clamp_direct.description: If non-zero, the maximum value for a direct sample, higher values will be scaled down to avoid too much noise and slow convergence at the cost of accuracy

sample_clamp_indirect.name: Clamp Indirect
sample_clamp_indirect.description: If non-zero, the maximum value for an indirect sample, higher values will be scaled down to avoid too much noise and slow convergence at the cost of accuracy

debug_bvh_type.name: Viewport BVH Type
debug_bvh_type.description: Choose between faster updates, or faster render

enum_items.name: Dynamic BVH
enum_items.description: Objects can be individually updated, at the cost of slower render time

enum_items.name: Static BVH
enum_items.description: Any object modification requires a complete BVH rebuild, but renders faster

debug_use_spatial_splits.name: Use Spatial Splits
debug_use_spatial_splits.description: Use BVH spatial splits: longer builder time, faster render

debug_use_hair_bvh.name: Use Curves BVH
debug_use_hair_bvh.description: Use special type BVH optimized for curves (uses more ram but renders faster)

debug_use_compact_bvh.name: Use Compact BVH
debug_use_compact_bvh.description: Use compact BVH structure (uses less ram but renders slower)

debug_bvh_time_steps.name: BVH Time Steps
debug_bvh_time_steps.description: Split BVH primitives by this number of time steps to speed up render time in cost of memory

use_camera_cull.name: Use Camera Cull
use_camera_cull.description: Allow objects to be culled based on the camera frustum

camera_cull_margin.name: Camera Cull Margin
camera_cull_margin.description: Margin for the camera space culling

use_distance_cull.name: Use Distance Cull
use_distance_cull.description: Allow objects to be culled based on the distance from camera

distance_cull_margin.name: Cull Distance
distance_cull_margin.description: Cull objects which are further away from camera than this distance

rolling_shutter_type.name: Shutter Type
rolling_shutter_type.description: Type of rolling shutter effect matching CMOS-based cameras

enum_items.name: None
enum_items.description: No rolling shutter effect used

enum_items.name: Top-Bottom
enum_items.description: Sensor is being scanned from top to bottom

rolling_shutter_duration.name: Rolling Shutter Duration
rolling_shutter_duration.description: Scanline "exposure" time for the rolling shutter effect

texture_limit.name: Viewport Texture Limit
texture_limit.description: Limit texture size used by viewport rendering

enum_items.name: No Limit
enum_items.description: No texture size limit
Limit texture size to 128 pixels
Limit texture size to 256 pixels
Limit texture size to 512 pixels
Limit texture size to 1024 pixels
Limit texture size to 2048 pixels
Limit texture size to 4096 pixels
Limit texture size to 8192 pixels

texture_limit_render.name: Render Texture Limit
texture_limit_render.description: Limit texture size used by final rendering

enum_items.name: No Limit
enum_items.description: No texture size limit
Limit texture size to 128 pixels
Limit texture size to 256 pixels
Limit texture size to 512 pixels
Limit texture size to 1024 pixels
Limit texture size to 2048 pixels
Limit texture size to 4096 pixels
Limit texture size to 8192 pixels

use_fast_gi.name: Fast GI Approximation
use_fast_gi.description: Approximate diffuse indirect light with background tinted ambient occlusion. This provides fast alternative to full global illumination, for interactive viewport rendering or final renders with reduced quality

enum_items.name: Replace
enum_items.description: Replace global illumination with ambient occlusion after a specified number of bounces

enum_items.name: Add
enum_items.description: Add ambient occlusion to diffuse surfaces

ao_bounces.name: AO Bounces
ao_bounces.description: After this number of light bounces, use approximate global illumination. 0 disables this feature

ao_bounces_render.name: AO Bounces Render
ao_bounces_render.description: After this number of light bounces, use approximate global illumination. 0 disables this feature

tile_size.name: Tile Size
tile_size.description: Render high resolution images in tiles of this size, to reduce memory usage. Tiles are cached to disk while rendering to save memory

debug_use_cuda_adaptive_compile.name: Adaptive Compile
debug_use_cuda_adaptive_compile.description: Compile the Cycles GPU kernel with only the feature set required for the current scene

debug_use_optix_debug.name: OptiX Module Debug
debug_use_optix_debug.description: Load OptiX module in debug mode: lower logging verbosity level, enable validations, and lower optimization level

debug_use_hip_adaptive_compile.name: Adaptive Compile
debug_use_hip_adaptive_compile.description: Compile the Cycles GPU kernel with only the feature set required for the current scene

debug_use_metal_adaptive_compile.name: Adaptive Compile
debug_use_metal_adaptive_compile.description: Compile the Cycles GPU kernel with only the feature set required for the current scene

gi_diffuse_bounces.name: Diffuse Bounces
gi_diffuse_bounces.description: Number of times the light is reinjected inside light grids, 0 disable indirect diffuse light

gi_visibility_resolution.name: Irradiance Visibility Size
gi_visibility_resolution.description: Size of the shadow map applied to each irradiance sample

gi_glossy_clamp.name: Clamp Glossy
gi_glossy_clamp.description: Clamp pixel intensity to reduce noise inside glossy reflections from reflection cubemaps (0 to disable)

gi_irradiance_pool_size.name: Irradiance Pool Size
gi_irradiance_pool_size.description: Size of the irradiance pool, a bigger pool size allows for more irradiance grid in the scene but might not fit into GPU memory and decrease performance

taa_render_samples.name: Render Samples
taa_render_samples.description: Number of samples per pixel for rendering

use_taa_reprojection.name: Viewport Denoising
use_taa_reprojection.description: Denoise image using temporal reprojection (can leave some ghosting)

ray_tracing_method.name: Tracing Method
ray_tracing_method.description: Select the tracing method used to find scene-ray intersections

enum_items.name: Light Probe
enum_items.description: Use light probes to find scene intersection

enum_items.name: Screen-Trace
enum_items.description: Raytrace against the depth buffer. Fallback to light probes for invalid rays.

use_shadow_jitter_viewport.name: Jittered Shadows (Viewport)
use_shadow_jitter_viewport.description: Enable jittered shadows on the viewport. (Jittered shadows are always enabled for final renders).

clamp_surface_direct.name: Clamp Surface Direct
clamp_surface_direct.description: If non-zero, the maximum value for lights contribution on a surface. Higher values will be scaled down to avoid too much noise and slow convergence at the cost of accuracy. Used by light objects.

clamp_surface_indirect.name: Clamp Surface Indirect
clamp_surface_indirect.description: If non-zero, the maximum value for indirect lighting on surface. Higher values will be scaled down to avoid too much noise and slow convergence at the cost of accuracy. Used by ray-tracing and light-probes.

clamp_volume_direct.name: Clamp Volume Direct
clamp_volume_direct.description: If non-zero, the maximum value for lights contribution in volumes. Higher values will be scaled down to avoid too much noise and slow convergence at the cost of accuracy. Used by light objects.

clamp_volume_indirect.name: Clamp Volume Indirect
clamp_volume_indirect.description: If non-zero, the maximum value for indirect lighting in volumes. Higher values will be scaled down to avoid too much noise and slow convergence at the cost of accuracy. Used by light-probes.

volumetric_start.name: Start
volumetric_start.description: Start distance of the volumetric effect

volumetric_end.name: End
volumetric_end.description: End distance of the volumetric effect

volumetric_tile_size.name: Resolution
volumetric_tile_size.description: Control the quality of the volumetric effects. Higher resolution uses more memory.

enum_items.description: Full resolution
Render this effect at 50% render resolution
Render this effect at 25% render resolution
Render this effect at 12.5% render resolution
Render this effect at 6.25% render resolution

volumetric_samples.name: Steps
volumetric_samples.description: Number of steps to compute volumetric effects. Higher step count increase VRAM usage and quality.

volumetric_sample_distribution.name: Exponential Sampling
volumetric_sample_distribution.description: Distribute more samples closer to the camera

volumetric_ray_depth.name: Volume Max Ray Depth
volumetric_ray_depth.description: Maximum surface intersection count used by the accurate volume intersection method. Will create artifact if it is exceeded. Higher count increases VRAM usage.

use_volumetric_shadows.name: Volumetric Shadows
use_volumetric_shadows.description: Cast shadows from volumetric materials onto volumetric materials (Very expensive)

volumetric_shadow_samples.name: Volumetric Shadow Samples
volumetric_shadow_samples.description: Number of samples to compute volumetric shadowing

use_volume_custom_range.name: Volume Custom Range
use_volume_custom_range.description: Enable custom start and end clip distances for volume computation

use_fast_gi.name: Fast GI Approximation
use_fast_gi.description: Use faster global illumination technique for high roughness surfaces

fast_gi_thickness_near.name: Near Thickness
fast_gi_thickness_near.description: Geometric thickness of the surfaces when computing fast GI and ambient occlusion. Reduces light leaking and missing contact occlusion.

fast_gi_thickness_far.name: Far Thickness
fast_gi_thickness_far.description: Angular thickness of the surfaces when computing fast GI and ambient occlusion. Reduces energy loss and missing occlusion of far geometry.

fast_gi_quality.name: Trace Precision
fast_gi_quality.description: Precision of the fast GI ray marching

fast_gi_step_count.name: Step Count
fast_gi_step_count.description: Amount of screen sample per GI ray

fast_gi_ray_count.name: Ray Count
fast_gi_ray_count.description: Amount of GI ray to trace for each pixel

enum_items.name: Ambient Occlusion
enum_items.description: Use ambient occlusion instead of full global illumination

enum_items.name: Global Illumination
enum_items.description: Compute global illumination taking into account light bouncing off surrounding objects

fast_gi_distance.name: Distance
fast_gi_distance.description: If non-zero, the maximum distance at which other surfaces will contribute to the fast GI approximation

fast_gi_bias.name: Bias
fast_gi_bias.description: Bias the shading normal to reduce self intersection artifacts

fast_gi_resolution.name: Resolution
fast_gi_resolution.description: Control the quality of the fast GI lighting. Higher resolution uses more memory.

enum_items.description: Full resolution
Render this effect at 50% render resolution
Render this effect at 25% render resolution
Render this effect at 12.5% render resolution
Render this effect at 6.25% render resolution

bokeh_max_size.name: Max Size
bokeh_max_size.description: Max size of the bokeh shape for the depth of field (lower is faster)

bokeh_threshold.name: Sprite Threshold
bokeh_threshold.description: Brightness threshold for using sprite base depth of field

bokeh_neighbor_max.name: Neighbor Rejection
bokeh_neighbor_max.description: Maximum brightness to consider when rejecting bokeh sprites based on neighborhood (lower is faster)

use_bokeh_jittered.name: Jitter Camera
use_bokeh_jittered.description: Jitter camera position to create accurate blurring using render samples (only for final render)

bokeh_overblur.name: Over-blur
bokeh_overblur.description: Apply blur to each jittered sample to reduce under-sampling artifacts

motion_blur_depth_scale.name: Bleeding Bias
motion_blur_depth_scale.description: Lower values will reduce background bleeding onto foreground elements

motion_blur_max.name: Max Blur
motion_blur_max.description: Maximum blur distance a pixel can spread over

motion_blur_steps.name: Motion steps
motion_blur_steps.description: Controls accuracy of motion blur, more steps means longer render time

shadow_pool_size.name: Shadow Pool Size
shadow_pool_size.description: Size of the shadow pool, a bigger pool size allows for more shadows in the scene but might not fit into GPU memory

shadow_ray_count.name: Shadow Ray Count
shadow_ray_count.description: Amount of shadow ray to trace for each light

shadow_step_count.name: Shadow Step Count
shadow_step_count.description: Amount of shadow map sample per shadow ray

light_threshold.name: Light Threshold
light_threshold.description: Minimum light intensity for a light to contribute to the lighting

use_overscan.name: Overscan
use_overscan.description: Internally render past the image border to avoid screen-space effects disappearing

overscan_size.name: Overscan Size
overscan_size.description: Percentage of render size to add as overscan to the internal render buffers

resolution_scale.name: Resolution
resolution_scale.description: Determines the number of rays per pixel. Higher resolution uses more memory.

enum_items.description: Full resolution
Render this effect at 50% render resolution
Render this effect at 25% render resolution
Render this effect at 12.5% render resolution
Render this effect at 6.25% render resolution

use_denoise.name: Denoise
use_denoise.description: Enable noise reduction techniques for raytraced effects

denoise_temporal.name: Temporal Accumulation
denoise_temporal.description: Accumulate samples by reprojecting last tracing results

denoise_bilateral.name: Bilateral Filter
denoise_bilateral.description: Blur the resolved radiance using a bilateral filter

screen_trace_thickness.name: Screen-Trace Thickness
screen_trace_thickness.description: Surface thickness used to detect intersection when using screen-tracing

trace_max_roughness.name: Raytrace Max Roughness
trace_max_roughness.description: Maximum roughness to use the tracing pipeline for. Higher roughness surfaces will use fast GI approximation. A value of 1 will disable fast GI approximation.

screen_trace_quality.name: Screen-Trace Precision
screen_trace_quality.description: Precision of the screen space ray-tracing

name.name: Name
name.description: Unique name used in the code and scripting

pass_debug_sample_count.name: Debug Sample Count
pass_debug_sample_count.description: Number of samples per pixel taken, divided by the maximum number of samples. To analyze adaptive sampling

pass_render_time.name: Render Time
pass_render_time.description: Reports time per pixel in milliseconds. Supported only on CPU render devices

use_pass_volume_scatter.name: Volume Scatter
use_pass_volume_scatter.description: Contribution of paths that scattered in the volume at the primary ray

use_pass_volume_transmit.name: Volume Transmit
use_pass_volume_transmit.description: Contribution of paths that transmitted through the volume at the primary ray

use_pass_shadow_catcher.name: Shadow Catcher
use_pass_shadow_catcher.description: Pass containing shadows and light which is to be multiplied into backdrop

denoising_store_passes.name: Store Denoising Passes
denoising_store_passes.description: Store the denoising feature passes and the noisy image. The passes adapt to the denoiser selected for rendering

compute_device_type.name: Compute Device Type
compute_device_type.description: Device to use for computation (rendering with Cycles)

peer_memory.name: Distribute memory across devices
peer_memory.description: Make more room for large scenes to fit by distributing memory across interconnected devices (e.g. via NVLink) rather than duplicating it

metalrt.name: MetalRT
metalrt.description: MetalRT for ray tracing uses less memory for scenes which use curves extensively, and can give better performance in specific cases

enum_items.name: Off
enum_items.description: Disable MetalRT (uses BVH2 layout for intersection queries)

enum_items.name: On
enum_items.description: Enable MetalRT for intersection queries

enum_items.name: Auto
enum_items.description: Automatically pick the fastest intersection method

use_hiprt.name: HIP RT
use_hiprt.description: HIP RT enables AMD hardware ray tracing on RDNA2 and above

use_oneapirt.name: Embree on GPU
use_oneapirt.description: Embree on GPU enables the use of hardware ray tracing on Intel GPUs, providing better overall performance

kernel_optimization_level.name: Kernel Optimization
kernel_optimization_level.description: Kernels can be optimized based on scene content. Optimized kernels are requested at the start of a render. If optimized kernels are not available, rendering will proceed using generic kernels until the optimized set is available in the cache. This can result in additional CPU usage for a brief time (tens of seconds)

enum_items.name: Off
enum_items.description: Disable kernel optimization. Slowest rendering, no extra background CPU usage

enum_items.name: Intersection only
enum_items.description: Optimize only intersection kernels. Faster rendering, negligible extra background CPU usage

enum_items.name: Full
enum_items.description: Optimize all kernels. Fastest rendering, may result in extra background CPU usage
